chat.author: Siddhant Ray
chat.text: @anh vo One possible use case is for LLM application developers and infra providers (who in turn build on top of public cloud resources). They can benefit from the flexibility in pricing and movement latency. It in theory reduces issues like vendor lock etc.

chat.author: Jean Queralt
chat.text: I find it ironic(?) that in the quest to build the Magic Abstraction Layer we are going to be building a programming language for Genies... pushing us to focus on making sure that humans both use the same words and share the dictionary.

chat.author: Anh Vo
chat.text: @Siddhant Ray: Thank you. I was thinking that for inference cloud providers, a dist. kv cache within one cloud but across multiple regions would be useful as a service. I am not sure of an inference use case from an enterprise can span multiple clouds.

chat.author: Siddhant Ray
chat.text: The aspect of distributed KV Cache within one cloud but many regions is definitely more immediate and realizable. The second case is more of a longer term vision. An analogy I can think about is  is something similar to an internet of different college campus networks for data sharing perhaps. Would be happy to discuss more offline.
